findings.reason: The paired natural isomorphisms have opposite degree/content directions. Explicit paired squares materially clarify which Schur functor and image residue functor occur on each block, without replacing the complete proof.
findings.action: Appended two content-indexed tikzcd comparison squares and explanatory projector conventions to final Remarks.

correction: Added raising and lowering comparison squares commuting up to natural isomorphism, with beta=alpha+alpha_i and source/target content cuts explicit.

diagram_math_checks.evidence: The residue-translation definition gives f_i:O_alpha^d -> O_(alpha+alpha_i)^(d+1) and the reverse e_i. The Schur-functor definition gives pi_alpha:O_alpha^d -> B_alpha-mod. Both squares use precisely these domains and the matching pi_beta.

Statement and step 2.1 identify f_i^H(X)=B_beta u_(alpha,i) tensor_(B_alpha) X and e_i^H(Y)=u_(alpha,i)Y with beta=alpha+alpha_i. The prose explicitly uses image algebras, applies both content cuts and retains the typed-coset interpretation, so no unsupported full cyclotomic identification is asserted.

Step 1.2 constructs tau for induction and step 1.1 rho for restriction. Step 2.1 restricts these to residue/content projectors and proves exactly f_i^H pi_alpha is naturally isomorphic to pi_beta f_i^O and e_i^H pi_beta to pi_alpha e_i^O. Central congruence symbols denote those comparisons, with no strict equality or extra equivalence asserted.

Step 2.1 proves last-dot eigenvalue i corresponds to dual-Casimir eigenvalue -n-i under rho; the explanatory text states this and the lowering V* factor rather than identifying V and V*. No additional unit/counit arrows or duality relations are introduced.

visual_checks.result: Both diagrams compiled to SVG in actual ItemBody SSR; all node labels, all eight functor arrows and both central congruence symbols are visible, correctly oriented, separated and unclipped. The original first preview failed on unsupported TikZ text command; the final source uses mathrm and final receipt has zero failures.

limitations: Local ItemBody SSR preview, not production route or metadata footer; 32 unrelated reference-map parse diagnostics are retained in preview artifacts.
